chunks: He said: Abu Hafs Umar ibn Muhammad al-Sayrafi reported to me from Muhammad ibn Hammam al-Iskafi, who reported from Ahmad ibn Idris, who reported from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa al-Ash'ari, from Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from Fudayl ibn Uthman, from Muhammad ibn Shurayh, who said: I heard Abu Abdillah Ja'far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon them both, say:

Indeed, Allah has made our authority (wilaya) obligatory, and has made loving us a duty. By Allah, we do not speak according to our whims, nor do we act according to our personal opinions. We say nothing except what our Lord, Mighty and Majestic, has said.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq say about the divine authority (wilaya) of the Ahlulbayt?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS), the sixth Imam, declares that the authority (wilaya) of the Ahlulbayt is divinely ordained and that love for them is obligatory. He further emphasizes that the Imams do not speak from personal desire or opinion but only convey what Allah has commanded.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 4. He said: Abu Hafs Umar ibn Muhammad al-Sayrafi reported to me from Muhammad ibn Hammam al-Askafi who reported from Ahmad ibn Idrees, who reported from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa al-Asha’ri, from ‘Ali ibn No-man, from Fudhail ibn Uthman, from Muhammad ibn Shurayh who said: I heard Abu Abdillah Ja’far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon him, say:

"Surely, Allah has enforced our authority, and made it obligatory upon people to love us. By Allah, we do not say anything out of caprice or our desire, and we do not act according to our views. We do not say except that which our Lord, Most High, has said."
